gitCommit.subject: Fix mobile landing page: center hero CTA, stop bank marquee overflow
gitCommit.body:
Fix mobile landing page: center hero CTA, stop bank marquee overflow

The hero email signup form wasn't centered on mobile while the rest of
the hero content was. Separately, the infinite bank-logo marquee was a
flex item under a column layout with align-items:flex-start, so it sized
to its unrolled track's full content width instead of the viewport,
letting mobile browsers pinch/auto-zoom out to reveal the overflow.

Adds a Playwright regression test asserting the hero CTA is centered and
the document never exceeds viewport width on mobile.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019DsvoVpXubsgHN59138zPj
